'''Thomas Earl Gardner''' (born February 8, 1985) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who played briefly in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).

A {{convert|6|ft|5|in|m|adj=on}} [[guard (basketball)|guard]], Gardner played three seasons of college basketball at the [[University of Missouri]]. He was named to the All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Third Team in 2006 after averaging 19.7 [[points per game]] in 28 games. After college, he played professionally in [[Belgium]].<ref>[http://mutigers.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/102407aab.html Former Tiger Thomas Gardner Seeing NBA Dreams Come True] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080922034221/http://mutigers.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/102407aab.html |date=September 22, 2008 }}. Retrieved November 16, 2007.</ref>

Gardner made his NBA debut with the [[Chicago Bulls]] on November 15, 2007, scoring two points in five minutes against the [[Phoenix Suns]]. On November 20, in what would be his last game as a Bull, Gardner scored a career-high 14 points against [[Denver Nuggets|Denver]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/playerfile/thomas_gardner/ NBA.com Player File]. Retrieved November 16, 2007.</ref> He was waived on December 7, 2007, to make room for [[Demetris Nichols]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/bulls/news/gardner_nichols_071207.html Bulls waive Gardner; claim Demetris Nichols]. Retrieved December 8, 2007.</ref>

Gardner signed with the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in August 2008 after averaging 16.3 points per game in the [[Rocky Mountain Revue]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20080814223750/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/53962/20080811/hawks_sign_gardner_hunter_to_deals/ Hawks sign Gardner, Hunter to deals]. Retrieved on August 12, 2008.</ref> In September 2009, he joined the [[Memphis Grizzlies]]<ref>[http://www.commercialappeal.com/news/2009/sep/28/optimistic-memphis-grizzlies-tout-chemistry-media-/ Optimistic Memphis Grizzlies tout chemistry at media day]</ref> but was waived on October 8, 2009.<ref>[http://www.commercialappeal.com/news/2009/oct/08/free-agent-guard-gardner-waived-grizzlies/ Free agent guard Gardner waived by Grizzlies]</ref>

On December 28, 2009, he returned to Belgium to sign with the [[Antwerp]] Giants.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nieuwsblad.be/sportwereld/article/detail.aspx?articleid=DMF28122009_009|title = Antwerp Giants strikt gewezen NBA-speler Thomas Gardner}}</ref>
